description: Apply Swebsy's built-in scroll-reveal animation in one step — a smart, per-section staggered entrance on headings, text, images, buttons, and cards (navbars/footers skipped). Prefer this over hand-placing animate-* classes whenever the user asks to animate the page or site, or wants a consistent reveal.

scope.description: Animate just the current page (default) or every page in the site.

name: swebsy_animate_page
